title: Rajesh & Others v. State of U.P. & Another
disposition: Listed for a future date (adjournment order; no substantive order passed)
headnote: Not a substantive Supply Code case — a bare interlocutory order in a Section 482 Cr.P.C. application, merely recording that the applicant's counsel had died, granting an opportunity to engage new counsel, and listing the matter after one month. No electricity-related holding, reasoning, or authority appears in the order.

holding_units.topic: Bare adjournment order with no substantive content
holding_units.holding: The order merely records that the applicant's counsel is reported dead, grants an opportunity to engage new counsel, and lists the matter after one month; it contains no reasoning, holding, or discussion of any Supply Code or Electricity Act provision.
